caption: The drawing depicts a design of a tall, rectangular grandfather clock presented in both a technical and a colored illustration. On the left, the clock is rendered as a line drawing in black ink with measurements written along the edges, showing the clock from the front and indicating its structure, sections, and dimensions. The central portion features the same grandfather clock drawn and shaded in brown to emulate the appearance of wood, with detailed clock face at the top displaying Roman numerals, ornate corner decorations, and two clock hands. To the right of the central colored clock, two detailed drawings of sections of the clock face are presented: the lower one shows the circular clock dial with Roman numerals, the hands set to a time, and decorative motifs at the corners; the upper one features a semi-circular design with additional ornamental elements including a smaller clock or moon phase within a decorated arch. The drawing is set against an off-white background, and all features are rendered in shades of brown, black, and grey. The entire composition is organized in a rectangular format, with clear separation between the technical line drawing, the rendered object, and the detailed close-ups.
title: Grandfather's Clock (Old Pine)
